# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in contributing to the LevelFour Go SDK.

## Code Generation

Most of the code in this repository is auto-generated by [Fern](https://buildwithfern.com/) from our API definition. Generated files are marked with:

```
// Code generated by Fern from our API Definition; DO NOT EDIT.
```

**Do not submit pull requests that modify generated files** — they will be overwritten on the next generation cycle.

## Safe to Edit

The following directories contain hand-written code and accept contributions:

- `levelfour/` — Developer-facing client, error helpers, logging
- `middleware/` — HTTP middleware integration
- `examples/` — Usage examples

## After Fern Regeneration

After Fern regenerates the SDK, run the alias script to keep the single-import re-exports in sync:

```bash
./scripts/gen_aliases.sh
```

This updates `levelfour/aliases.go` with type aliases and function references for all root-package exports. Then run the header fix script:

```bash
./scripts/fix_headers.sh
```

This rewrites Fern's generated file headers to the Go-canonical `// Code generated` format recognized by `go vet` and editors.

## Adding API Methods

New API methods come from the OpenAPI spec, not hand-written code. If you need a new endpoint:

1. Open a GitHub issue describing the endpoint
2. We update the OpenAPI spec in `levelfour-api`
3. Fern regenerates the SDK automatically

## Setup

### Prerequisites

- Go 1.24 or later
- [golangci-lint](https://golangci-lint.run/welcome/install/)
- [pre-commit](https://pre-commit.com/) (recommended)

### Install Hooks

```bash
pre-commit install
```

This runs `gofmt`, `go mod tidy`, `go build`, `go test`, `go vet`, and `golangci-lint` on every commit.

### Using the Repository from Source

```bash
go mod edit -replace github.com/LevelFourAI/levelfour-go=/path/to/local/levelfour-go
```

### Running Tests

```bash
go test -race ./...
```

### Linting

```bash
golangci-lint run
```

### Formatting

```bash
gofmt -w .
```

### Adding Examples

Each example is a standalone Go module in `examples/`:

```bash
mkdir examples/my_example
cd examples/my_example
go mod init github.com/LevelFourAI/levelfour-go/examples/my_example
```

Create a `main.go` and run with `go run .`. Use `LEVELFOUR_API_KEY` env var for authentication.

## Reporting Issues

Please open a GitHub issue for bug reports and feature requests. For security vulnerabilities, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
